getting there

Venue & Travel

Venue

Taj Mussoorie Foothills. Nestled in the Shivalik foothills of the Himalayas, we are calling it home for two days.

✎ a little trail through our weekend

Travel

By air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant (~1 hour drive from the venue).

By train: Nearest railway station is Dehradun Railway Station (~30 min drive from the venue).

By road: ~4 hours by road from Delhi.

Stay

Room allocation will be done at the property.
